report_identity.report_title: Baguio Green Group Limited Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: Baguio Green provides Hong Kong environmental services, mainly cleaning, waste management and recycling, landscaping, and pest management.

segments.name: Waste management and recycling business
segments.source: Annual Report 2025 MD&A pages 9-10 and note 5

business_overview.revenue_model: Service contracts for environmental and related services and goods, with major exposure to Hong Kong government and quasi-government customers.
business_notes: Two major customers contributed HK$1,314,551,000, over half of 2025 revenue.
Unexpired service contracts at 31 December 2025 were HK$2,535,603,000, down from HK$3,887,470,000 at 31 December 2024.
The group employed 7,980 employees at 31 December 2025, so payroll and working capital cash needs are material.

non_recurring_items.item: Gain on disposal of property, plant and equipment
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Asset disposal gain included in other income, gains and losses; not treated as recurring operating profit.

non_recurring_items.item: Change in fair value of investments in life insurance
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Fair value gain on unquoted life insurance policies for key management.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2025 notes 6 and 17, pages 71 and 82

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Government subsidies; no assurance of recurrence disclosed.

funds_assets.item: Cash and bank balances other than time deposits
funds_assets.business_substance: Demand bank balances and cash on hand; includes HK$641,000 in Chinese Mainland and HK$31,000 pledged for banking facilities.

funds_assets.item: Time deposits with maturity less than 3 months when placed
funds_assets.business_substance: Short maturity bank deposits included in cash and cash equivalents.
Deposits pledged to banks to secure bank borrowings; not detachable until related facilities are released.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 notes 22 and 27, pages 85 and 89

operating_assets.business_substance: Service receivables, mostly current by invoice ageing; HK$79,463,000 pledged for banking facilities.

operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 statement of financial position, page 45

operating_assets.business_substance: Operating land, buildings, motor vehicles, vessels and equipment.
operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 statement of financial position and MD&A capital expenditure section, pages 45 and 11

operating_assets.business_substance: Leased lands, offices and nurseries used in operations.
operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 statement of financial position and MD&A charges section, pages 45 and 11

investment_assets.item: Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss
investment_assets.business_substance: Life insurance policies for key management, executed in Hong Kong, no fixed maturity and no quoted market price; fair value based on surrender value.

other_assets.business_substance: Prepayments, deposits, other receivables and non-current receivable from an associate.

other_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 statement of financial position, page 45

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Secured HKD bank borrowings, all current or repayable on demand; interest 2.75%-5.85%.
Recognised lease liabilities for lands, offices and nurseries used in operations.
financing_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025 statement of financial position and MD&A, pages 45 and 11

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Supplier payables, generally 30-60 day credit period.
Billings in advance of performance under recycling contracts.

operating_liabilities.item: Accruals, deposits received and other payables
operating_liabilities.business_substance: Mainly accrued wages, defined benefit obligations and other accrued expenses.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2025 and 2024 operating cash flow exceeded parent net profit, but both years benefited from receivable collection and 2025 profit included a large PPE disposal gain. Maintenance capex is estimated conservatively around HK$35 million using recent purchase of PPE and operating asset needs; 2023 cash flow details were not in the 2025 annual report.

gaps: The 2025 annual report does not split cash by listed parent versus each operating subsidiary.
The 2025 annual report gives 2023 profit in the five-year summary, but not 2023 operating cash flow and capital expenditure in the extracted text.
Maintenance versus growth capital expenditure is not separately disclosed; maintenance capex is estimated from recent PPE purchases and service operations.
Exact tax, remittance and dividend leakage for extracting subsidiary cash is not disclosed.
